This ensures that if a system failure occurs partway through the operation, none of the steps executed so far will take effect, preventing inconsistent states such as debiting one account without crediting another [2][4]. Additionally, atomicity implies that the intermediate states of the transaction are invisible to other concurrent transactions until the transaction is successfully completed [1][4].
